images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. First-person view from a chair inside a sunlit Korean family kitchen at 7:40 in the morning, framed by the player's own eyelids: soft dark-red curved lid edges intrude from the top and bottom of the frame, as if the eyes are only half open. Hand-painted watercolor illustration style with visible paper grain, warm cream and apricot palette, low morning sun pouring through a curtained window, dusty light shafts, steam rising from a white mug, an orange eye-drop bottle beside round glasses on a wooden table ringed by a pulsing dashed memory circle, a black cat sleeping on a chair. Minimal serif HUD: large centered countdown "12.0초" draining with a thin amber bar labeled "오늘 뜰 수 있는 시간", a seven-bar day timeline shrinking from 12 to 0 seconds, a pinned handwritten paper memo "오늘 눈으로 봐 둘 것" with checkboxes, and a translucent binaural panel showing sound sources around a head icon. Gentle vignette, tender and quietly anxious mood.

images.screen: B · 밤 — 남은 시간 0초, 소리로 방을 본다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same kitchen at night after sight is gone: an almost fully black screen where the room exists only as faint dashed chalk-white memory outlines of the window, table, wall clock and sleeping cat, slowly drifting. Concentric white and pale-peach sound rings expand from glowing points — a ticking wall clock upper left, the mother's voice to the right, rain at the window, a purring cat low right — and a bright ripple spreads from where the player just tapped. A small outlined head icon sits at the center as the listener. Minimalist thin serif typography: giant centered "0.0초" under the label "남은 시간", a struck-through list of the day's shrinking seconds at top right, and a softly glowing subtitle "엄마 · 오른쪽에서" above a line of dialogue. Deep ink-black palette with warm chalk highlights, film grain, intimate binaural atmosphere, calm grief rather than horror. The struck-through list at top right shows exactly seven entries: "12초", "10초", "8초", "6초", "4초", "2초" struck through, and "0초" highlighted at the bottom — no other numbers.
